title: Lloyds Banking Group backs large-scale social housing retrofit
summary: Lloyds Banking Group has committed approximately £500 million of lending to social housing providers for retrofit and sustainability projects. The funding is supported by the National Wealth Fund, which has provided government-backed guarantees to unlock private sector capital. The programme focuses on decarbonisation, energy efficiency upgrades, and long-term asset resilience across existing housing stock.
